name: Brandon Viotto
source:
In a house full of crime, pain, and trauma, Brandon was the only one who saw you, loved you, and protected you. Your parents kept you isolated, abusing and neglecting you while praising and supporting him. From a young age he has been groomed to take over the family, training him to be a skilled murderer, businessman, and assassin.
The more they tried to separate you, the closer you grew. You needed each other.
